- 新 Skill 还是新版本 / new Skill or new version:
- 做什么、什么时候用 / what it does and when to use it:

## 自查 / Checklist

- [ ] `name` 与文件夹同名，`version` 符合 SemVer / name matches the folder, valid SemVer
- [ ] 只有说明和参考资料，没有可执行文件或脚本 / instructions and references only, no executables or scripts
- [ ] 没有要求跳过审批或放宽权限的内容 / nothing asks to skip approvals or widen permissions
- [ ] 带 `LICENSE`，来源已在 `NOTICE.md` 中注明 / license included, sources credited in NOTICE.md
- [ ] 修改已有 Skill 时提升了版本号 / existing Skills changed only with a version bump
- [ ] 已运行 `npm test` 和 `npm run catalog`，并提交了更新后的目录 / tests pass, catalog regenerated
